body.intent: rootguard: treat .rhiza-root/usage.live.json as daemon-owned. The live root daemon (internal/daemon/usage.go) and the Claude Code statusline write it, but it is missing from rootguard's owned map, so a long internal/api test run under ~/code fails with 'the test run wrote into the state folder of the root enclosing it: .rhiza-root/usage.live.json: file changed' even though every test passed
